 Best NBA Parlays Today: Top Same-Game Parlays & Combos for Thursday, Nov. 19
 Chris Vasile 
 • Betting Analyst 
 13+ years betting experience 
 Updated: 
Nov 19, 2026 , 03:00 PM ET
 • 4 min read 
 Quinn Allen, Shawn Krest, Todd Cordell, and Chris Walder share their favorite NBA parlays for Thursday, Nov. 19, featuring four same-game combos across tonight's slate.
 Jump to section:

 Photo By - Reuters Connect. Darius Garland, Brayden Burries, Cameron Boozer, NBA. 
 Tonight's NBA parlays feature four same-game combos for Thursday, Nov. 19, with a mix of spreads, team totals, and player props.
 Our Covers analysts are looking for value in San Antonio's defense, Minnesota's third-quarter play, Portland's matchup with Milwaukee, and a struggling Golden State offense.
 All four games tip off at 8 p.m. ET. Here's the full card, with each analyst's reasoning and links to our individual game previews.
 For more standalone bets, check out our  NBA picks .

 Time: 8 p.m. ET
 TV: KTLA / ClipperVision
 Analyst: Quinn Allen
 Combo: 6.50x 
 Clippers +15.5
 Under 227.5
 Darius Garland Over 6.5 assists
 San Antonio ranks third in defensive rating and allows just 105.9 points per game. That makes the Under attractive, even if Los Angeles keeps the game close. The Spurs also lose some offensive firepower without Dylan Harper.
 Darius Garland has recorded at least seven assists in three straight games and averages 6.9 across 13 contests. He has fallen short of seven assists just four times, giving the final leg a strong recent trend.
 For the full matchup breakdown, read our Clippers vs Spurs predictions .
 Knicks vs Timberwolves
 Time: 8 p.m. ET
 TV: NBA TV
 Analyst: Shawn Krest
 Combo: 4.70x 
 Timberwolves moneyline
 Under 217.5
 Timberwolves -0.5 third-quarter spread
 Minnesota's scoring has dipped by 5.6 points per game since Anthony Edwards went down, although LaMelo Ball and Ayo Dosunmu have helped pick up the slack. The Timberwolves have hit the Under in three straight and five of their last six, while the slow-paced Knicks have gone Under in four of six.
 The third-quarter leg is the difference-maker. New York ranks 23rd in third-quarter scoring margin and has been outscored by 3.3 points per game in that period over its last three. Minnesota owns the league's third-best third-quarter differential at plus-4.1.
 For the full matchup breakdown, read our Knicks vs Timberwolves predictions .
 Trail Blazers vs Bucks
 Time: 8 p.m. ET
 TV: BlazerVision / Bucks+
 Analyst: Todd Cordell
 Combo: 7.29x 
 Trail Blazers +9.5
 Sidy Cissoko 4+ rebounds
 Brayden Burries 20+ PRA
 Portland's strong two-way play and fresher legs give it an advantage against Milwaukee, even if the Trail Blazers manage minutes for banged-up players.
 Sidy Cissoko has grabbed at least four rebounds in all four meetings with teams ranked in the bottom 10 in defensive rating. Brayden Burries has seen his points, rebounds, and assists production increase without Ousmane Dieng , who is out again tonight.
 For the full matchup breakdown, read our Trail Blazers vs Bucks predictions .
 Warriors vs Grizzlies
 Time: 8 p.m. ET
 TV: NBC Sports Bay Area / Peacock
 Analyst: Chris Walder
 Combo: 7.00x 
 Grizzlies -6.5
 Warriors Under 109.5 team points
 Cedric Coward Over 3.5 assists
 Golden State has scored no more than 94 points in three straight games without Stephen Curry, including 94 against New Orleans' 26th-ranked defense. No Warrior has averaged more than 15 points during that stretch, while leading scorer Yaxel Lendeborg has shot just 29.6% from the field.
 For Memphis, Cedric Coward has averaged 4.8 assists and 7.3 potential assists across his last six appearances, clearing 3.5 assists in every one. He also dished out five in Wednesday's win over Cleveland.
 For the full matchup breakdown, read our Warriors vs Grizzlies predictions .
